supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records show repeated failed network logons for NWD\svc-render on FILE-NWD-01 from 13:31:03 through 13:46:04 UTC. The 4625 failures report substatus 0xc000006a, and corresponding domain-controller records report failed credential validation or Kerberos pre-authentication.
The failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals, identify FILE-NWD-01 as the workstation, and repeatedly show the same lsass.exe process ID on that host.

The cadence and source host are consistent with the supplied inventory description of svc-render as a FILE-NWD-01 job that re-authenticates each minute. The failures begin just after the scheduled 13:30 UTC password rotation, making an unupdated job credential a plausible explanation.

known_telemetry_limitations: The evidence provided consists of authentication failures; it does not include job execution, password-change, or service-configuration records.
The supplied records end at 13:46:04 UTC and do not establish whether the credential was later updated or whether authentication recovered.
These records cover the specified svc-render failures and do not establish whether other activity occurred during the review window.
claims_not_established: Whether the scheduled password rotation actually occurred at 13:30 UTC.
Whether the RenderQueue job was updated manually, and whether its failed attempts stopped after the records provided.
Whether any successful svc-render logons or other account activity occurred outside the supplied records.
additional_evidence_needed: Check the domain-controller password-change audit records for svc-render around 13:30 UTC.
Review FILE-NWD-01 RenderQueue/job and service logs to confirm the job's credential update and subsequent run results.
Review authentication records after 13:46 UTC for successful svc-render logons or continued failures.
